$comment: Sizes are world pixels (320 x 180 view). Painted files are 4x. See content/README.md. The panels of the cave (the Black Frieze, the mammoths, the finger tracings, the spotted horses) are drawn by the game from the level data and are not listed here; they are wall art, never collided with, and their notes live in their beat folders.

assets.what: The rock of the cave: wet bedded limestone, darker than anything above ground, no surface.
The same, with a lit top edge where a lamp catches it.
The clay floor of the galleries, below the surface. Soft enough to take a footprint and keep it.
The clay floor with its walked surface on top.
The underside of a walkway slab, where the tour path is cut through.
A poured slab of the visitor walkway, seen from above: the surface everybody walks on.
One print of the boy, left in soft clay and sealed under a skin of calcite. Facing the way in.
The same print the other way about. A dozen of them survive and they run in two directions.
A calcite disc seen edge on: a plate forced out of a crack in the rock and set hard. Its top edge is a ledge, and the way up the hall is one of these to the next.
